• T0 loads metadata dictionary snapshots into DuckDB
• T1 uses NetworkX DiGraph + Tarjan's SCC for cycles
• T3 stages wave batches and manages prerequisite locks
• T4 maps BW source systems to DSP Space Connections
• T5 converts characteristics & texts to #DIMENSION CSN
• T6 transpiles ABAP Start/End/Field routines to SQL Views
• T7 maps ADSOs to #FACT & staging local tables
• T8 translates CompositeProviders into Relational Views
• T9 translates BEx queries to DSP Analytic Models
• T10 translates RSPC chains to Datasphere Task Chains
• T10 converts Analysis Authorizations into DAC policies
• T11 reconciles record counts & SHA-256 metric sums
• T12 Streamlit dashboard acts as master control cockpit
• Space-level schema isolation and user role governance
• Core CSN v1.0 schema notation for dimensions and facts
• Multidimensional Analytic Models exposed for SAC & Power BI
• Automated Delta Replication via DP Agent & Cloud Connector
• Strict wave dependency locking: No Wave N+1 without Wave N
• 0.01% reconciliation tolerance threshold on numerical sums
• Fallback manual review queue for unparsed complex ABAP
